summary: AES Corp filed an 8-K disclosing merger-related shareholder litigation and demand letters. AES is the target of a going-private merger with Horizon Parent, L.P. and Merger Sub, backed by Global Infrastructure Management, EQT Infrastructure VI, and other investors. The merger was announced March 1, 2026, with a stockholder vote set for June 26, 2026. Two lawsuits and 15 demand letters challenge alleged proxy disclosure deficiencies but seek to enjoin the merger or claim damages. AES denies merit. Watch for supplemental disclosures or court activity before the vote; deal risk-arb angle centers on potential delay from litigation.
